turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will take care of you, O-lan, and do what you wish, but you must not talk like this. You are not going anywhere, you are going to rest and get well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't worry about me, I will take care of Father and the family, and I will make sure that the feast is prepared exactly as you want it. You just rest and get well, I will do everything.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I have prepared the room next to yours, it's warm and quiet, and I've brought in some fresh herbs to help with the fever.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have made a plan for the feast, and it must be carried out as I have said. See that the pigs are slaughtered on the right day, and the wine is fetched from the cellar. I want everything to be perfect for my son's marriage.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must stop talking like this, you are exhausting yourself. I will see to the feast, I will make sure it is perfect for our son's marriage, but you must rest and let me take care of you.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I will make sure the pigs are slaughtered on the right day and the wine is fetched from the cellar. I'll take care of everything, just rest and get well.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I have also prepared the traditional tea for your recovery, and it's brewing in the kitchen, should you need it

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not be comforted by soft words, Wang Lung. I must see this done, or I will not be at peace.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, I swear to you on the life of our son that I will see to every detail of the feast, just as you have planned it. I will not let you worry about this, my love.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I'll make sure to help Father with the arrangements, don't worry, Mother, we'll make it a beautiful feast, just like you want.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: May I have your permission, Mother, to help the eldest son with the preparations? I want to make sure that everything is done just right, as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not looking for comfort, Wang Lung, but for the knowledge that my son will be provided for and happy, as I have always wished for him.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you exhausting yourself with this, my love. You must rest and let us handle the arrangements.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I'll take care of the arrangements with the maid's help. We'll make sure everything is perfect, just like you want.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: May I, with your permission, Mother, help the eldest son choose a suitable wife for him? I have heard that there are several young women from good families who are looking for husbands.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you think of this, daughter. See to it that the eldest son finds a good woman, one who will take care of him and bring him joy. But we must be careful, and choose someone who is worthy of him.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not permit you to burden yourself with this, O-lan. You must rest and let us handle the arrangements for the eldest son's marriage.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I'll take care of finding a suitable wife, with the maid's help, of course. I'll choose someone who will make you proud and make me happy. But first, let's get started right away, shall we?

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: But, if I may suggest, eldest son, perhaps we should consult with the matchmaker who helped find me a suitable husband? She may know of some young women who would be a good fit for you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am tired, but this must be done, Wang Lung. Let the eldest son find a wife, but see that she is a good one, one who will take care of him and honor me, even after I am gone.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
